title: USAJOBS Search API
adapter_hint: Paginated public job announcement search; preserve request parameters, response metadata, and raw announcement identifiers before normalization.
proof_notes: Fixture search responses, validate required announcement fields, and record API parameter envelope in provenance receipts.
license_policy_notes: Use public API metadata as source evidence; do not copy restricted site content or infer eligibility beyond declared fields.

title: USAJOBS API Reference and Code Lists
adapter_hint: Mine code-list endpoints and API reference pages for stable filters, occupational series, agencies, and locations.
proof_notes: Version source URLs and preserve code-list labels, identifiers, and retrieval date in enrichment receipts.
license_policy_notes: Treat as authoritative public reference metadata; keep candidate mappings reviewable before promotion.

title: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities Public API
adapter_hint: Adapter should model posted date, response deadline, notice type, solicitation number, set-aside, NAICS, PSC, place of performance, and attachment references separately.
proof_notes: Contract tests should cover pagination, filters, date windows, null deadline handling, and attachment-link receipts.
license_policy_notes: Keep solicitation documents as source references or artifacts with policy review; candidate digest is not legal advice.

title: USAspending API
adapter_hint: Use award search and recipient/agency endpoints to create market-history signals for opportunity evaluation.
proof_notes: Validate award identifiers, fiscal-year filters, award amounts, and agency/recipient joins with golden fixtures.
license_policy_notes: Use as public spending evidence; mark derived competitiveness scores as heuristic candidates until reviewed.

title: Grants.gov API
adapter_hint: Model grant opportunity search separately from package/document retrieval and deadline normalization.
proof_notes: Contract tests should cover opportunity status, closing dates, eligibility categories, agency fields, and no-result responses.
license_policy_notes: Keep opportunity summaries source-linked and avoid eligibility claims without source-backed fields.

title: Simpler.Grants.gov Developer Resources
adapter_hint: Track emerging API patterns and schema vocabulary for future Grants.gov modernization adapters.
proof_notes: Keep API-version and schema-change receipts so adapters can be regenerated deterministically.
license_policy_notes: Use only public developer documentation and published schema contracts.

title: Data.gov Catalog API
adapter_hint: Mine dataset metadata, distributions, organizations, formats, tags, and API endpoints for source discovery candidates.
proof_notes: Validate CKAN/DCAT fields and preserve original package IDs, distribution URLs, and modified timestamps.
license_policy_notes: Dataset license and access fields must be copied into candidate proof receipts before reuse.

title: Census NAICS
adapter_hint: Maintain NAICS lookup, title search, year-specific code versions, and crosswalk receipts.
proof_notes: Store taxonomy version/year and fixture checks for code, title, and parent hierarchy lookups.
license_policy_notes: Use authoritative taxonomy labels; keep automated industry classifications candidate-only until reviewed.

title: Acquisition.gov Product and Service Code Manual
adapter_hint: Extract PSC codes, descriptions, and category hierarchy for procurement enrichment.
proof_notes: Validate exact code lookup, parent category mapping, and manual-version provenance.
license_policy_notes: Use PSC labels as public taxonomy evidence; automated mappings remain review candidates.

title: SBA Table of Size Standards
adapter_hint: Map NAICS codes to size standard thresholds and effective-date metadata for small-business eligibility signals.
proof_notes: Fixture tests should cover NAICS lookup, threshold units, effective dates, and ambiguous/missing codes.
license_policy_notes: Eligibility outputs are decision-support candidates, not official determinations.

title: BLS Standard Occupational Classification
adapter_hint: Use SOC groups and occupation codes to normalize job and labor-market records.
proof_notes: Keep SOC edition/version and validate code/title hierarchy with golden examples.
license_policy_notes: Role mappings inferred from text remain candidate signals until reviewed.

title: O*NET Web Services
adapter_hint: Use occupation, skills, tasks, abilities, and technology-skill endpoints for job/opportunity capability enrichment.
proof_notes: Record API version, occupation code, and endpoint response hashes for enrichment receipts.
license_policy_notes: Respect O*NET attribution and terms; derived skill fits remain candidate-only.

title: OpenAPI Specification
adapter_hint: Convert operation objects, parameters, request bodies, responses, auth schemes, and error envelopes into primitive endpoint wrappers.
proof_notes: Schema tests should compile representative specs and assert visible input/output edges match operation contracts.
license_policy_notes: Generate wrappers from public specs only after license and ToS review.

title: JSON Schema Specification
adapter_hint: Use JSON Schema as the default contract language for primitive input/output edges and validation receipts.
proof_notes: Validate candidate schemas against a local metaschema and golden valid/invalid examples.
license_policy_notes: Schemas must describe contracts, not copy proprietary examples into fixtures.

title: Frictionless Table Schema
adapter_hint: Use for tabular source contracts, CSV/Parquet edge typing, and data-quality proof receipts.
proof_notes: Fixture tests should validate fields, constraints, missing values, and primary keys.
license_policy_notes: Dataset-level license metadata still travels separately from schema contracts.

title: OpenLineage Specification
adapter_hint: Use lineage events to connect source observation, normalization, enrichment, grouping, and promotion proof receipts.
proof_notes: Validate namespace/name/run facets and emit stable run IDs for primitive-factory stages.
license_policy_notes: Lineage events may expose source identifiers; keep privacy boundaries explicit.

title: SPDX Specifications
adapter_hint: Use SPDX identifiers and SBOM vocabulary for license and package provenance proof gates.
proof_notes: Fixture tests should normalize common SPDX license IDs and flag unknown expressions.
license_policy_notes: License gate output is a policy signal, not legal advice.

title: SLSA Specification
adapter_hint: Use SLSA vocabulary to score source/build provenance for implementation-backed primitive candidates.
proof_notes: Promotion receipts should distinguish source-backed, implementation-backed, and reproducible-build-backed candidates.
license_policy_notes: Supply-chain scores are risk signals and require human review for promotion.

title: CycloneDX Specification
adapter_hint: Use CycloneDX BOMs to attach dependency and vulnerability evidence to implementation-backed primitives.
proof_notes: Validate BOM parse fixtures and preserve tool name/version for generated receipts.
license_policy_notes: Do not promote implementation-backed primitives with unresolved high-risk dependency findings.

title: Sigstore Documentation
adapter_hint: Use signing and transparency-log concepts for artifact attestation lanes in the primitive factory.
proof_notes: Proof plans should separate signed artifact verification from source-code license review.
license_policy_notes: Signature presence is not a license grant; keep license gates independent.

title: in-toto Attestation Framework
adapter_hint: Use attestation predicates to represent primitive build, test, benchmark, and promotion proof receipts.
proof_notes: Validate predicate type, subject digest, materials, and builder metadata for candidate receipts.
license_policy_notes: Attestations prove process claims only when issuer identity and materials are trusted.

title: GitHub REST API
adapter_hint: Mine repositories, code search metadata, releases, licenses, dependency files, topics, and issues for implementation-backed candidate discovery.
proof_notes: Record repository URL, commit SHA, license metadata, API response hash, and rate-limit envelope.
license_policy_notes: Do not copy code into candidate cards; use metadata and source references until license review passes.

title: PyPI JSON API
adapter_hint: Mine package metadata, releases, classifiers, project URLs, dependencies, and distribution hashes for Python primitive candidates.
proof_notes: Preserve package name/version, file hashes, license classifier, project URLs, and release timestamps.
license_policy_notes: Package metadata is source evidence; implementation reuse requires license and security review.
